events.title: Math Grad Show and Tell Seminar: The surprising asymptotics of bingo
events.summary: Explore the surprising mathematical asymptotics of bingo in this seminar. The presenter will discuss the expected time to achieve a bingo on an N by N grid, a topic with intriguing mathematical implications.
events.imageAlt: Math Grad Show and Tell Seminar: The surprising asymptotics of bingo
events.experienceId: experience:["ann arbor","east hall","math grad show and tell seminar the surprising asymptotics of bingo"]

evidence.description: Inspired by Okta Verify Bingo in the graduate lounge, consider an N by N square of cells. Every second, a uniformly random cell is chosen (with replacement) and filled in. What is the expected amount of time until a bingo, i.e. a fully filled in row, column, or diagonal? How does this grow asymptotically as N increases? The answer involves some interesting mathematics and may surprise you.

events.title: Tropical precarity
events.summary: Explore the intersections of performance, visual art, gender expression, and cultural resistance in Puerto Rico through a conversation with acclaimed artists Freddie Mercado Velázquez and Mickey Negrón. This event delves into queer aesthetics and cultural resistance.

evidence.description: The Latina/o Studies and the Contemporary Performance in Puerto Rico Working Group, in partnership with the Department of American Culture, invites you to Tropical Precarity: Drag and Visual Arts in Puerto Rico, a special performance and panel discussion. evidence.description: Planet Ant Theatre presents SHE KILLS MONSTERS by Qui Nguyen, December 4-19, 2026, at Ant Hall. When Agnes Evans loses her teenage sister Tilly, she realizes she barely knew her. Tilly's Dungeons & Dragons notebook pulls Agnes into a fantastical world of epic quests, homicidal fairies, snarling ogres, and 90s pop culture as she tries to reconnect with her sister and find the courage she never knew she had. Equal parts comedy, heartfelt drama, and action-packed adventure, the play celebrates the power of great storytelling and the geek and warrior in all of us.
